definitions.gloss: giving in; losing patience; being worn down by persistence
definitions.explanation: Yielding because the other party's persistence outlasts your resistance. Losing not on merit but because you run out of stamina or patience to keep refusing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦せがまれて→せがむ：17931_segamu⟧{根負|こんま}け⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave in after my child kept begging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれて→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧、{根負|こんま}け⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧。
examples.english: After being asked repeatedly, I gave in and accepted.

examples.japanese: ⟦しつこい→しつこい：06498_shitsukoi⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}マン→営業マン：08749_eigyouman⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{根負|こんま}け⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was worn down by the persistent salesman and ended up signing the contract.

notes:
{根負|こんま}け means giving in because someone else's persistence outlasts your resistance. The person yielding doesn't truly want to, but can no longer keep refusing.

FORMS:
{根|こん} (stamina, persistence) + ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧ (losing) — literally "losing in persistence."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {根負|こんま}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give in, to be worn down
- {根負|こんま}け⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧〜⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: gave in and did something
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{根負|こんま}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give in to someone's persistence

USAGE:
Implies reluctant surrender. The person who {根負|こんま}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is not persuaded by logic — they simply run out of willpower to keep saying no. Common with children begging parents, persistent salespeople, or repeated requests.
